summary: Coons cosponsored the 2025 Antisemitism Awareness Act, directing the Education Department to use the IHRA definition for campus investigations, and in 2026 voted against resolutions blocking $446.8 million in U.S. arms sales to Israel, including D9 bulldozers and 1,000-pound bombs, having defended a similar 2025 vote in a press release. A 2024 ceasefire call and a September 2026 bill sanctioning Israeli E1 settlement construction show sympathy for Palestinian conditions short of opposing the IHRA framework or U.S. military transfers.
